The 3rd Step Prayer originates from the Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous and is essential in the recovery journey. It emphasizes surrendering to a higher power and seeking guidance beyond oneself.

You don’t need to be in a 12-step program to appreciate the beauty and wisdom of this prayer. It speaks to universal themes of humility, surrender, and connection.
